snippet.title: T B Skyen
snippet.description: Hi. My name is TBSkyen and I...... talk about stuff? Yeah let's go with that. Comics, animation, character design, art, narrative, writing - whatever I think I have something interesting or useful to say about. There's a lot of League of Legends stuff on this channel, but it's not ALL I do, check out my videos on the animation of Sonic Mania sometime.
